description: Qwen3-0.6B batch-1 decode: where the decoder-block kernels come from. TensorRT's own kernels (static_v3 + CUDA graphs), the hand-written fused blocks, and the same five blocks with kernels generated by PR 4914's KernelGenerator (cached in the workload's kernel cache: its kernel_cache argument, else $TORCHTRT_KERNEL_CACHE, else the default directory), against the default build and the best Inductor setup
